name: file-attachment
description: Expands @filepath references in user input to file contents in <file-include> format

enabled.description: Whether this extension is enabled. Set to false to disable the extension entirely.

maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size in bytes to expand for text files (default: 100KB)

maxImageSize.description: Maximum image size in bytes to attach on @refs (default: 10MB, matching the read tool's image cap)

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to expand per input
